dedupe_keys.name: multi stage samsung lithium ion battery ageing experiments

description: The multi-stage battery-ageing research team publishes measurements from 279 Samsung INR21700-50E lithium-ion cells. The first experimental stage uses factorial and Latin-hypercube designs, while the second adds parameter-focused optimal experimental design. The deposit supplies experiment metadata and per-cell archives covering calendar and cycle ageing. Access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. This 2024 collection can calibrate empirical or physical degradation simulations and test storage-lifetime assumptions used in model-pypsa planning. A caveat is that different test protocols and reference checks create different exposures, so cells should not be pooled without their experimental metadata. The repository and article also use different condition totals. Individual archives, corrupted-file handling and fitted degradation relationships were not checked by downloading or running the data.
